validation.selected_metrics: hits@100, labeled-recall@100 and known-positive yield@100, NOT true precision on unknown code

limitations: All scored candidate nodes are already named STT_FUNC ELF functions; name/root membership masked but function boundaries visible to the graph.
Masked positives are public-known roots, systematically favoring strong connectivity; results do NOT validate real unknown routine discovery.
Disconnected graph node is UNKNOWN distance not large distance; indirect edges and data/code symbol gaps are missing.
No independently verified silicon experiment or novel ROM API; 3 revisions share code ancestry, no independent statistical replication.
Other unlabeled candidates are unjudged, not false positives. Do not treat known-positive yield as new-function precision.
Farthest method top-ranked sparse components with no rooted execution evidence; dual root-directed evidence covers a small minority.
Results should not be used to tune on frozen holdout then claim unbiased confirmation; boundary-hidden tests needed.
